results.term_definition: A blackbody is defined as a body that absorbs radiation that falls on it without reflecting any of it. Therefore, it is a hypothetical object with perfect absorption and perfect reflection for all radiation and all wavelengths. The spectral distribution of thermal energy radiated by a blackbody (the pattern of intensity of blackbody radiation over a range of wavelengths and frequencies) depends only on its temperature. The radiation from stars, and their effective temperatures and colors, can be described by assuming that they are blackbodies.
